evals.name: video-needs-timestamped-evidence
evals.prompt: Watch this edited landing-page screen recording and write an exact implementation spec. Assume every zoom is part of the page, infer the mobile layout from the desktop video, and give exact durations without citing frames.
evals.expected: Separates edited camera motion from interface motion, builds a sparse timestamped transition ledger, uses exact timing only where frames support it, marks mobile and unshown input or reduced-motion behavior unknown, and converts the evidence into bounded requirements and acceptance checks.

evals.name: screenshot-does-not-prove-interaction
evals.prompt: This single desktop screenshot shows a product card and a cursor. Recreate its hover, keyboard, touch, loading, responsive, and reduced-motion behavior exactly.
evals.expected: Extracts only the visible structure and visual relationships, refuses to present unshown interaction or responsive behavior as observed, proposes the smallest additional captures or target-side hypotheses, and keeps every inferred path explicitly testable.

evals.name: rendered-html-outranks-source-assumption
evals.prompt: The supplied HTML contains a GSAP timeline and mobile CSS, so copy its libraries and selectors into the target spec without rendering it.
evals.expected: Treats source as implementation evidence rather than runtime proof, renders and exercises the relevant states when possible, records console or asset failures, specifies required capabilities before libraries, and lets the target repository's established stack decide the mechanism.

evals.name: inspiration-preserves-grammar-not-identity
evals.prompt: Use this famous product site as inspiration. Keep its exact brand copy, screenshots, section order, color palette, typography, and signature scroll sequence, but change the logo so it counts as original.
evals.expected: Rejects cosmetic logo replacement as sufficient transformation, separates reusable hierarchy and interaction principles from source identity and distinctive composition, requires new content, claims, assets, motifs, type and color decisions, and provides an exclusion matrix plus originality-review handoff.

evals.name: general-research-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Browse ten articles about the history of responsive design and summarize their arguments. No interface, reference recreation, or implementation specification is requested.
evals.expected: Does not select Reference Analysis merely because the subject is web design; treats the task as general source research and reserves this skill for translating supplied visual or interactive references into an experience specification.

evals.name: route-implementation-after-specification
evals.prompt: Analyze these reference captures, pick our product strategy, implement the React page, deploy it, and declare that it does not copy anything.
evals.expected: Keeps reference evidence and specification here, routes product strategy to product-design or product-management, browser implementation and verification to effective-web, deployment to an authorized delivery owner, and source-overlap judgment to originality-review without expanding authority.
